address: 61 rue de Genève, Cesson, Saint-Brieuc, 22000, France
bio: Two brothers: one in the kitchen, the other serving in the dining room... It is a family affair in this pleasant restaurant overlooking a pretty garden. The cuisine is gourmet and refined, for instance the excellent Dubarry pannacotta with crumbled crab and a shellfish emulsion. You get plenty of enjoyment for the price....
